name: deds_generate_otp
description: Sends OTP for DEDS authentication. Does NOT verify OTP. Fails if Aadhaar invalid or mobile not registered.

name: deds_verify_otp
description: Verifies OTP and returns session_token. Does NOT check eligibility or submit applications. Fails if OTP expired or incorrect.

name: deds_check_eligibility
description: Checks farmer's eligibility for DEDS/poultry subsidy based on category (general/SC-ST/women), project type, and prior subsidy history. Returns eligibility_status with reasons. Requires session_token. Does NOT submit application. Fails if farmer has already received DEDS subsidy for same project type (duplicate prevention) or if required details are missing.

session_token.description: Token returned after Aadhaar OTP authentication. Required for all tools except authentication.

name: deds_submit_project
description: Submits a detailed project proposal for DEDS subsidy. Transitions application_status to 'submitted'. Requires session_token. Farmer must be eligible. Does NOT approve the application or sanction loans. Fails if farmer is ineligible, proposal is incomplete, or duplicate application exists.

session_token.description: Token returned after Aadhaar OTP authentication. Required for all tools except authentication.

project_cost.description: Estimated total project cost in INR.

name: deds_apply_loan
description: Submits a loan application to a bank for the DEDS project. Subsidy is credit-linked — loan must be sanctioned for subsidy eligibility. Transitions loan_status to 'applied'. Requires session_token. Application must be submitted first. Does NOT sanction loan. Fails if no application exists or application is rejected.

session_token.description: Token returned after Aadhaar OTP authentication. Required for all tools except authentication.

application_id.description: Unique identifier of the DEDS application.

name: deds_track_loan_status
description: Tracks loan_status ('not_applied', 'applied', 'sanctioned', 'rejected', 'disbursed'). Requires session_token. Does NOT modify loan. Fails if loan_id is invalid.

session_token.description: Token returned after Aadhaar OTP authentication. Required for all tools except authentication.

loan_id.description: Unique identifier of the loan application.

name: deds_calculate_subsidy
description: Calculates subsidy amount based on project cost, beneficiary category, and project type. Subsidy percentage varies (25-33% for general, 33% for SC/ST/women). Returns total subsidy, farmer's share, and cap limits. Requires session_token. Does NOT disburse subsidy. Fails if application is rejected or project cost is invalid.

session_token.description: Token returned after Aadhaar OTP authentication. Required for all tools except authentication.

name: deds_track_project_status
description: Tracks project_status ('not_started', 'in_progress', 'completed', 'verified'). Project implementation is required before subsidy release. Requires session_token. Does NOT modify project. Fails if application_id is invalid.

session_token.description: Token returned after Aadhaar OTP authentication. Required for all tools except authentication.

name: deds_verify_project
description: Records verification/inspection result for the implemented DEDS project. Transitions project_status to 'verified' upon passing. Verification is MANDATORY before subsidy disbursement. Requires session_token. Does NOT disburse subsidy. Fails if project is not 'completed', inspection finds defects, or assets are not operational.

session_token.description: Token returned after Aadhaar OTP authentication. Required for all tools except authentication.

name: deds_track_subsidy
description: Tracks subsidy_status ('not_initiated', 'pending', 'approved', 'disbursed', 'failed'). Subsidy is released ONLY after project verification and loan sanction. Requires session_token. Does NOT initiate disbursement. Fails if project not verified or loan not sanctioned.

session_token.description: Token returned after Aadhaar OTP authentication. Required for all tools except authentication.

name: deds_get_scheme_details
description: Returns detailed information about DEDS scheme including eligible projects, subsidy percentages, caps, and bank requirements. PUBLIC tool — no session required. Does NOT check individual eligibility. Advisory only. Fails if scheme details are temporarily unavailable.

name: deds_get_bank_list
description: Returns list of banks and financial institutions supporting DEDS loans in a region. Requires session_token. Does NOT apply for loans. Fails if no banks found in specified region.

session_token.description: Token returned after Aadhaar OTP authentication. Required for all tools except authentication.

name: deds_schedule_inspection
description: Schedules a physical inspection of the implemented project. Project must be in 'completed' status. Transitions inspection_status to 'scheduled'. Requires session_token. Does NOT perform inspection. Fails if project not completed or scheduling conflict.

session_token.description: Token returned after Aadhaar OTP authentication. Required for all tools except authentication.

name: deds_cancel_application
description: Cancels a DEDS application. Only possible when application_status is 'submitted' or 'under_review'. Requires session_token. Does NOT refund or modify loans. Fails if application is already approved, rejected, or project started.

session_token.description: Token returned after Aadhaar OTP authentication. Required for all tools except authentication.

name: deds_raise_grievance
description: Raises a DEDS grievance. Categories: 'loan_rejected', 'application_rejected', 'inspection_failure', 'subsidy_not_received', 'delay_in_processing'. Must check status first. Requires session_token. Fails if category is invalid.

session_token.description: Token returned after Aadhaar OTP authentication. Required for all tools except authentication.

name: deds_track_grievance_status
description: Tracks DEDS grievance. Requires session_token. Fails if grievance_id invalid.

session_token.description: Token returned after Aadhaar OTP authentication. Required for all tools except authentication.
